Items are submitted afterwards, one at a time, each as an ordinary run keyed `{batch id}:{index}`. A failed item does not stop later ones. An ambiguous item becomes `outcome_unknown` and is reconciled, never resubmitted. Repeating the same key and body returns 200 with the batch and resumes items that have no run; a different body with the same key is a 409. The key space is separate from the runs API.

post.description: Expand a batch and validate every item against the pinned workflow revision without submitting anything or contacting ComfyUI. A grid is the cartesian product with parameter names sorted and the last name varying fastest. The server limit on items is `max_items_cap`. post.description: Start downloading one LLM model. This is the only operation that downloads, and it runs only on this explicit request: never at startup, on saving settings, in doctor or after a missing-model error. Returns 202 once the endpoint accepted the request; observe it through the pull resources. Errors: 409 when this model is already being pulled (the problem names the pull), 422 for an invalid name, 429 when too many pulls run, 501 when the endpoint has no native pull API.

delete.description: Cancel a running pull. The response has state `cancelled`; a pull that already finished is returned unchanged. Cancelling closes the request to Ollama; partial downloads may remain and a later pull resumes them. A cancelled pull may still have installed the model if it finished just before the request closed, so `GET /models/llm` is the authoritative answer.

Progress frames are coalesced, so intermediate snapshots may be skipped; the sequence increases. A stream that ends without a terminal event was cut: read the pull again. 404 when the ID is unknown.

post.description: Analyse a ComfyUI API-format graph and propose a version 2 manifest. Read-only: nothing is written. The ID `import` is reserved. Send `{graph, name?}`; the body is limited to 2 MiB. A UI-format export is refused with the problem type `urn:genaimage:problem:workflow-ui-format`.

Write a confirmed import as a new user workflow: `<paths.workflows>/<id>/api-workflow.json` and `workflow.genaimage.json`, the manifest last. The manifest is validated strictly with the discovery rules and never corrected. An existing id, in the user root or any pack, is refused with 409 `urn:genaimage:problem:workflow-exists` and a `suggested_id` field. A graph that differs from `graph_sha256` is refused with 409 `urn:genaimage:problem:workflow-graph-mismatch` and an `expected_graph_sha256` field. When another manifest declares the written ID, the 409 `urn:genaimage:problem:workflow-ambiguous` carries `id` and `manifest_path`: the workflow was written and stays unavailable until the duplicate is removed or renamed. Repeating an identical confirmation returns 200 with the same result. The body is limited to 4 MiB.

409.description: `workflow-exists`, `workflow-graph-mismatch` or `workflow-ambiguous`
